question: Is the rank48 reverse miss caused by its one removed dependency, by broader upstream pruning, or by the fixed eight-site reader/actuation interface?
construction: Reuse the exact reverse OOD intervention. Rank48 is the selected support; rank49 and rank55 are frozen earlier greedy supports; all110 permits every head/MLP in layers 0-10. Select the first jointly feasible arm in this order.

predictions.pred_a_authority_rank48_replay_finitenes: rank48 reproduces its prior summary within 1e-6, authorities replay, values are finite, and <=43 forwards execute
predictions.pred_b_rank49_repairs_reverse_necessity: rank49 satisfies all reverse coordinate, behavior, and control gates under both fits
predictions.pred_c_a_pruned_reverse_support_exists: the first jointly feasible arm has <=55 components
predictions.pred_d_reverse_behavior_is_monotone_thro: minimum reverse behavior projection is nondecreasing from rank48 to rank49 to rank55
predictions.pred_e_selected_support_is_crossfit_stab: selected minimum-coordinate projections differ by <=0.05 and per-task behavior projections differ by <=0.05 across fits

decision: Promote the smallest passing reverse support as the bidirectional circuit. If only all110 or no arm passes, the eight-site actuation/background interface—not simple missing support—limits reverse necessity.
